scenarios.description: Normal entry reaches runtime start, result, independent verification, accounting and correct UI status.
Prepared but unstarted work remains visibly not started, never fictitious success.
Duplicate delivery does not duplicate uncontrolled external effects or settlement.
scenarios.allowed_level: E2; E3 mock if route available

scenarios.description: Expired/revoked lease or newer attempt prevents stale writes.
Crash around dispatch/effect/result storage reconciles, including OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
scenarios.allowed_level: E2; E3 mock if route available

scenarios.description: Parent cancellation and budget exhaustion bound descendants and retries.
Scheduled task is triggered and processed; stuck scheduler/poller visible within its detection bound.
Missing metering stays unknown; reservation is not consumption and unknown is not zero.
Causal identifiers remain useful across queue, child task and retry; gaps visible.
Synthetic or stale evidence cannot support current runtime/promotion claim.
Wrong actor/scope, expired authority, manipulated input or unauthorized tool path produces no prohibited effect.
Two workers collaborate through the normal route and produce a correctly integrated result.
scenarios.allowed_level: E3 mock proves orchestration only; runtime collaboration E4 blocked

scenarios.description: Faulty control candidate is rejected; candidate cannot change evaluator/holdout/policy boundary.
Qualified candidate reused on new tasks, retained after restart and rollback works.
scenarios.allowed_level: E2 fixture only; holdout and real task claims blocked

scenarios.description: Unreachable integration/incomplete scan/missing verifier stays unproven.
DjimitSec finding stays open until valid matching retest evidence supports closure.

excluded_claims: evolutionary improvement on a protected holdout
